summary: Validated requested non-slot table-game realism scope across backend and frontend using public URL. Backend regressions and new live API realism tests passed; simulation script executed successfully; customer UI flows for WAR, Baccarat, Blackjack, and Pikapokeri worked without JS/runtime errors.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested realism scope.
Optional maintainability: split monolithic /app/app.py and /app/templates/customer.html into smaller modules/components.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/app.py (~2400 lines) and /app/templates/customer.html (~3500 lines) remain high-risk monoliths for future regressions and difficult targeted QA.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested flows (WAR, Baccarat, Blackjack, Pikapokeri)

test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used: TestPelaaja / test123, player id 1.
seed_data_creation: No new seed users. Added temporary test points to player id 1 via /api/players/1/points/grant for repeatable game-flow testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live regression uses public URL from frontend/.env (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). If running pytest manually, export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env first; otherwise API tests that depend on BASE_URL skip. WAR UI stress run (25 rounds) showed no page errors and handled non-standard outcomes rendering.
rca of the issue: No product bug reproduced in this scope. One transient automation failure on Baccarat check was test-timing related (result container not yet populated during animation); resolved by increasing wait and adding robust success conditions. No API mocking used (MOCKED APIs: NONE).
